newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bond yields end up on tight cash liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields end up on tight cash liquidity.

text.p: South Korea's key bond yields closed higher on Tuesday due to concerns about the tight cash liquidity, dealers said.
They said cash liquidity remained tight despite the central bank's supply of 800 billion won through repurchase agreements.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.65 pct vs Monday's 11.50
* 3-mth CDs close at 11.68 pct vs Monday's 11.60
* Average overnight call at 11.50 pct vs Monday's 11.20
"The three-year yields are expected to rise further for another day or two because concerns continued over the tight cash liquidity," said Lee Chang-woo of Samsung Securities.
Dealers said the cash liquidity at banks was expected to remain tight until the weekend, the deadline for the central bank's review of reserve levels at banks.
